# Channel3 TypeScript SDK

[![fern shield](https://img.shields.io/badge/%F0%9F%8C%BF-Built%20with%20Fern-brightgreen)](https://buildwithfern.com?utm_source=github&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=readme&utm_source=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ffern-demo%2Fchannel3-ts-sdk)
[![npm shield](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@channel3/sdk)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@channel3/sdk)

The official TypeScript SDK for the [Channel3 API](https://channel3.docs.buildwithfern.com) — a universal product database powering AI shopping apps and agents.

## Documentation

Full API documentation and guides are available at [channel3.docs.buildwithfern.com](https://channel3.docs.buildwithfern.com).

## Runtime Compatibilities

| Requirement | Version |
|-------------|---------|
| Node.js | `>= 18.0.0` |
| TypeScript | `>= 4.5` (optional — works in plain JS too) |
| Module system | ESM and CommonJS (dual-package) |
| Browsers | Any environment with `fetch` (or pass a polyfill) |
| Edge runtimes | Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Deno |
| React Native | Supported |

## Installation

```sh
npm install @channel3/sdk
# or
yarn add @channel3/sdk
# or
pnpm add @channel3/sdk
```

## Authentication

The SDK authenticates via an `x-api-key` header. Pass your key when initializing the client:

```typescript
import { Channel3Client } from "@channel3/sdk";

const client = new Channel3Client({ apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY" });
```

You can also supply a function for dynamic key resolution (useful for key rotation):

```typescript
const client = new Channel3Client({
    apiKey: async () => getKeyFromVault(),
});
```

## Usage

### Search products

```typescript
const response = await client.products.search({
    query: "organic cotton t-shirt",
    limit: 10,
});

for (const product of response.products) {
    console.log(product.title, product.offers?.[0]?.price);
}
```

### Paginate through results

Search responses include a `nextPageToken` for cursor-based pagination:

```typescript
let pageToken: string | undefined;

do {
    const response = await client.products.search({
        query: "sneakers",
        pageToken,
    });

    for (const product of response.products) {
        console.log(product.title);
    }

    pageToken = response.nextPageToken ?? undefined;
} while (pageToken);
```

### Visual search by image

```typescript
const response = await client.products.imageSearch({
    imageUrl: "https://example.com/photo.jpg",
});
```

### Find similar products

```typescript
const response = await client.products.similar({
    productId: "prod-12345",
});
```

### Look up a product by URL

```typescript
const product = await client.products.lookup({
    url: "https://example.com/product/abc",
});
```

### Browse brands and categories

Cursor-paginated listing for brands and categories:

```typescript
const brands = await client.brands.list({ limit: 50 });
console.log(brands.items);       // Brand[]
console.log(brands.nextCursor);  // pass as `cursor` for the next page

const categories = await client.categories.list({ pageSize: 50 });
```

### Track prices

```typescript
// Start tracking
await client.priceTracking.start({ canonicalProductId: "prod-12345" });

// Get price history
const history = await client.priceTracking.getHistory({ canonicalProductId: "prod-12345" });

// List active subscriptions
const subs = await client.priceTracking.listSubscriptions();

// Stop tracking
await client.priceTracking.stop({ canonicalProductId: "prod-12345" });
```

## Type Intellisense

All request and response types are exported under the `Channel3` namespace for easy discovery:

```typescript
import { Channel3 } from "@channel3/sdk";

// Full autocomplete on request fields
const request: Channel3.SearchRequest = {
    query: "wireless headphones",
    limit: 20,
    filters: { gender: "female" },
    config: { country: "US", currency: "USD" },
};

// Response types are also typed
const response: Channel3.SearchResponse = await client.products.search(request);
```

Resource clients are accessible via dot notation — type `client.` in your editor to discover:

| Accessor | Methods |
|----------|---------|
| `client.products` | `search`, `imageSearch`, `similar`, `lookup`, `retrieve`, `enrich` |
| `client.brands` | `list`, `search`, `get` |
| `client.categories` | `list`, `search` |
| `client.priceTracking` | `start`, `stop`, `getHistory`, `listSubscriptions` |
| `client.websites` | `list` |

## Error Handling

The SDK throws typed errors per HTTP status code:

```typescript
import { Channel3Error, Channel3TimeoutError } from "@channel3/sdk";

try {
    await client.products.search({ query: "test" });
} catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Channel3Error) {
        console.log(err.statusCode); // 401, 402, 422, etc.
        console.log(err.message);
        console.log(err.body);
    }
}
```

## Advanced

### Retries

Automatic exponential backoff on 5xx and network errors (default: 2 retries):

```typescript
const response = await client.products.search(
    { query: "shoes" },
    { maxRetries: 5 },
);
```

### Timeouts

Default timeout is 60 seconds. Override per-client or per-request:

```typescript
const client = new Channel3Client({
    apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY",
    timeoutInSeconds: 30,
});

// Per-request
await client.products.search({ query: "shoes" }, { timeoutInSeconds: 10 });
```

### Abort Requests

```typescript
const controller = new AbortController();
await client.products.search({ query: "shoes" }, { abortSignal: controller.signal });
```

### Raw Response Access

Access HTTP headers and status alongside parsed data:

```typescript
const response = await client.products.search({ query: "shoes" });
console.log(response.rawResponse.status);
console.log(response.rawResponse.headers);
```
